Life Drain Lv. 1 Inflicts non-Attribute damage on an enemy with with 15 Power added to M. Atk. and re-absorbs 80% of the damage as HP.
Blaze Quake Lv. 1 Ignites nearby enemies, causing loss of 58 HP per second.
Aura Sink Lv. 1 Burns MP of the target and surrounding enemies with 16 power, additionally causing 8 MP to be lost per second.
Frost Flame Lv. 1 Strikes the target with magical cold flame, causing loss of 58 HP per tick.
Chant of Life Lv. 1 Recovers all party members HP by 5%. Recovers 12 HP per second for all party members.
Flame Chant Lv. 1 For party members: Cast. Spd. +15%.
Chant of Combat Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. For party members: P. Atk. +6% P. Def. +6%.
Chant of Critical Attack Lv. 1 Combines 'Focus' and 'Death Whisper' effects. For party members: P. Crit. Rate +10% P. Crit. Damage +15%.
Chant of Blood Awakening Lv. 1 Combines 'Haste' and 'Vampiric Rage' effects. For party members: Atk. Spd. +12% Recovers as HP 5% of melee damage dealt.
Chant of Movement Lv. 1 Combines 'Wind Walk' and 'Agility' effects. For party members: Speed +20 Evasion +1.
Chant of Berserker Lv. 1 For party members: P. Atk. +4% M. Atk. +8% Atk. Spd. +4% Cast. Spd. +4% Speed +4 P. Def. -4% M. Def. -8% Evasion -1.
Chant of Magic Lv. 1 Combines 'Empower' and 'Magic Barrier' effects. For party members: M. Atk. +25% M. Def. +10%.
Stun Attack Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 36 Power to stun an enemy. Over-hit is possible. While the effect is active, Resistance to Stun is significantly increased.
Fear Lv. 1 Frightens an enemy into fleeing.
Venom Lv. 1 Poisons the target, causing loss of 11 HP per second.
Seal of Chaos Lv. 1 Decreases Accuracy of nearby enemies by 9.
Dreaming Spirit Lv. 1 Causes an enemy to sleep.
Seal of Slow Lv. 1 Decreases Speed of nearby enemies by 20%.
Madness Lv. 1 Confuses an enemy into attacking random targets.
Seal of Binding Lv. 1 Holds nearby enemies.
Seal of Poison Lv. 1 Poisons nearby enemies, causing loss of 14 HP per second.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Soul Cry Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 and consumes 0 MP per second.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Magician's Movement Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Atk. Spd. -20%.
Spellcraft Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Cast. Spd. -50%.
Mana Recovery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: MP Regeneration +20%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.

Heavy Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Heavy Armor: P. Def. +12 Cast. Spd. +71% Atk. Spd. +25%.

Toughness Lv. 1 Resistance to Sleep/Hold/Poison +20%.
Anti Magic Lv. 1 M. Def. +10.
Quick Recycle Lv. 1 Decreases Reuse Delay for magic by 10%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Boost Mana Lv. 1 Increases Max MP by 30.
Fast Spell Casting Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +5%.
